subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, One candidate got 48% of the total valid votes. 18% of the votes were invalid. If the total number of votes was 17500, then what was the number of valid votes the other candidate got?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Valid votes percentage = 100% − 18% = 82%

Other candidate's share of valid votes = 100% − 48% = 52%

Required valid votes = Total votes × 82% × 52%

⇒ 17500 × (82 ÷ 100) × (52 ÷ 100)

⇒ 175 × 82 × 0.52 = 7462

**∴ The correct answer is 7462.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of votes = 17500

Invalid votes = 18%

One candidate's share of valid votes = 48%
